_note: This Actor charges ONE 'calendar-year' event per run regardless of dataset row count (verified manually: node scripts/smoke-local.mjs jewish-holidays-calendar --measure, and ACTOR_TEST_PAY_PER_EVENT smoke runs), so the generic charge/budgetCap per-row fields are intentionally omitted - they assume one charge per dataset row, which does not apply here. `rows` is checked BY INDEX (smoke.mjs), so it references index 0 (rows are sorted by date; the earliest 2026 event under the default include is Ta'anit Esther on 2026-03-02) and the last index, 31 (the trailing meta row).
